Subject: Lifespring GCP private offer — next steps and required timelines

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the call this morning. We are ready to move forward with Redwood's GCP private offer but Procurement asked me to formalize a short mutual action plan so we can align milestones with our finance and legal teams. Key constraints: 1) we need a signed PO + invoice routing by 7/12 to hit our July billing window; 2) SOC2 summary and data retention notes are required for our audit committee by 6/30.

Can you share a MAP that breaks down responsibilities, dates, and the billing path (GCP private offer -> invoice -> payment terms)? Also please include the onboarding acceptance criteria for our security team.

Attaching our internal purchase intake form (not attached here, will upload to your Drive if needed).

Best,
Laura Stevens
Director of Procurement
Lifespring Health
procurement@lifespringhealth.com

Laura — thanks, really helpful constraints. Draft MAP attached (Lifespring_MAP_v1.xlsx) plus a short SOC2 summary and the private-offer terms doc. High-level plan below:

- 6/20: Redwood to deliver MAP + SOC2 summary (attached) [Action: Redwood (Karthik)]
- 6/24: Lifespring legal to confirm required redlines to private-offer terms [Action: Lifespring]
- 6/27: Redwood to provide updated private-offer (if redlines) and invoice path + billing contact; DocuSign-ready agreement [Action: Redwood]
- 7/01: Lifespring procurement issues PO and returns DocuSign signature to Redwood [Action: Lifespring]
- 7/03: Redwood kick off onboarding; acceptance trials scheduled (2-week window) [Action: Redwood + Lifespring security]
- 7/12: Invoice generated and routed to Lifespring AP to meet July billing cycle [Action: Redwood finance -> Lifespring AP]

Notes: payment terms in the attached terms doc are Net30 by default. If Lifespring needs Net45 we can propose a short credit hold with finance approval; please flag.

I'll loop Hannah (sales operations) to confirm the invoice routing and Grace (CS/Onboarding) to prep acceptance criteria.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Quick internal note (please keep internal):

Karthik — I reviewed Lifespring's requested PO timing. Redwood finance can support invoice generation on 7/12 but needs the following to guarantee routing: correct billing contact (name + AP email), purchase order number on the invoice, and the signed DocuSign envelope to be completed by 7/01 EOD. From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2029-06-21T08:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Lifespring MAP — onboarding acceptance criteria

Adding acceptance details — draft to include in MAP (I edited the attached spreadsheet):

- Acceptance tests (security): verify private VPC peering configuration, KMS integration proof-of-concept, and encrypted at-rest verification on a 1-week trial dataset.
- Performance: 95th percentile token latency under 300ms for 2 concurrent inference threads during smoke tests.
- Data handling: retention policy set to 30 days with customer-managed keys option noted.
- Sign-off: Lifespring security + Redwood CS engineer must sign acceptance sheet.

I'll attach a short runbook (I'll upload to the Drive link in related_links) and prep the onboarding kickoff deck.

Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference

Karthik — thank you for the quick turnaround. The MAP looks good overall. A few items from our side:

1) Lifespring will target returning the signed DocuSign by 7/01 but Ben is checking with our budget owner for Net45 vs Net30. We should be able to confirm by 6/25.
2) Procurement requests that Redwood include an invoice example that shows the PO number placement and the specific GL codes we should populate; can you provide that?
3) Security asked for the network diagram and the KMS SLA; SOC2 summary is helpful but they want those two extra items. Can Redwood upload those to the Drive link?

If you can incorporate these small changes and re-upload the MAP and artifacts to the shared Drive, we'll circulate internally and aim for the 7/01 sign-off.

Laura
